Yardley Office Support Ends Charges for Repair Visits
By Theodore Sinclair
March 25
Yardley Office Support is replacing the fee it has charged office clients for each repair visit. Until now, the company has sent an invoice every time a technician was sent out. Under the new arrangement, clients instead register their individual machines with the company, and the number of machines a client registers decides how quickly the company responds when a problem is reported.
According to Vernon Middleton, the aim is to match the speed of service to how much a client depends on the company. "We wanted a simple and fair basis, one that ties our attention to how much equipment a client relies on us to look after," he said. Under the new terms, a client that registers five or more machines is promised same-day response, while a client with fewer than five is given next-day response.
Existing customers will be brought onto the new arrangement in stages over the next three months. Community News
Trentham Library to Close for Roof Repairs
By Jonas Eckhart, The Vale Chronicle
The town's busiest library branch, Trentham, will close on Tuesday, March 1, and is expected to remain closed until early June.
Although the repairs were originally scheduled for next year, it was the discovery of water damage above the reading room that caused them to be advanced. The town council has also increased the funds set aside for the project, and the additional money will pay for a renovated reading room that, once the branch reopens, will accommodate more readers than the one at Rushden, currently the largest in town.
In the meantime, each of Trentham's services has been relocated to another branch. The branches taking them over include Wadebridge, the town's oldest library, and Blaxton, its newest, which opened only last year.
"For our members, it will be business as usual, just at a different address," said Deborah Guthrie, the town's head librarian. The Library Services Office has published a full list of the temporary arrangements.
----------------------
Library Services Office
Where to go while the Trentham branch is closed
Service	Moves to	Please note
Borrowing and returns	Rushden branch	Open every day. Bring your library card.
Children's story hour	Wadebridge branch	Saturday mornings. No booking needed.
Evening reading group	Rushden branch	Monday evenings only. Sign up at the desk.
Computer help desk*	Blaxton branch	Thursday afternoons only. Please arrive early.
* Each help desk visit lasts twenty minutes. Sign in when you arrive.
Please do not wait until Trentham closes on Tuesday, March 1, to return or renew items borrowed there.
Questions about any service may go to staff at any open branch.
----------------------

Library Events This Week
Although the Trentham branch remains closed for repairs, two of its regular activities continue elsewhere this week.
Monday evening: the reading group will discuss a travel book, with Felix Kovacs leading the conversation.
Saturday morning: the children's story hour, read as usual by Iris Okafor, who has led it for six years.
The next listing of community events will appear in Sunday's edition.
